title: Crispy Garlic American Skillet Meal
description: A classic American-inspired skillet dish, featuring crispy garlic and easy-to-make ingredients.
instructions: Cook the Skillet Hash Browns according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, cook the Crispy Bacon until crispy.
Remove the cooked bacon from the skillet and set aside.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Crack the eggs into the skillet and scramble them.
Add the shredded American Cheese to the skillet and stir until melted.
Add the cooked Hash Browns and cooked bacon back into the skillet.
Stir everything together and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until the cheese is bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh chives.
